Add multiscale relative targets

add_multiscale_relative_targets.Rd

Adds feature representation targets expressed as proportions between zero and one of the total amount of each feature in the multiscale planning data.

Usage

add_multiscale_relative_targets(x, targets, data)

Arguments

x

A single-zone prioritizr ConservationProblem object.

targets

A numeric value or vector of proportions between zero and one. Supply either one value for all features or one value per problem feature. A named vector is matched to the problem feature names.

data

A multiscale_objective_data object returned by build_multiscale_objective_data().

Value

An updated ConservationProblem object with the targets added.

Details

Relative targets specify the minimum proportion of each feature that should be represented by the solution. Feature totals are calculated across the nested planning-unit hierarchy, allowing representation secured at different resolutions to contribute toward the same target.

A single target value is applied to every feature. An unnamed vector follows the feature order in the problem, and a named vector is matched by feature name and must provide a value for every feature.

See also

Other multiscale minimum-set: add_multiscale_min_set(), add_multiscale_min_set_objective(), build_multiscale_atoms(), build_multiscale_feature_atoms(), build_multiscale_objective_data(), eval_multiscale_atom_solution(), load_multiscale_feature(), multiscale_feature_cols()

Examples

h3_vec <- c("872a1072bffffff","882a1072b1fffff","882a1072b3fffff")

pu <- h3jsr::cell_to_polygon(h3_vec, simple = FALSE)
pu <- pu[match(h3_vec, pu$h3_address), ]

pu$res <- c(7L, 8L, 8L)
pu$area_km2 <- c(14, 2, 2)
pu$A <- c(3, 1, 2)
pu$B <- c(6, 2, 1)

maps <- build_h3_maps(pu)

ms_data <- build_multiscale_objective_data(pu, maps, feature_cols = c(A = "A", B = "B"))

p <- prioritizr::problem(pu,features = c("A", "B"),cost_column = "area_km2")
p <- add_multiscale_min_set_objective(p,ms_data)
p <- add_multiscale_relative_targets(p,c(B = 1/2, A = 2/3),ms_data)
